title: EvaluateResponse
description: Envelope returned by POST /v1/evaluate. Mirrors the published reference at https://docs.summitcognitive.ai/api/reference; the served /v1/openapi.json is authoritative.

verdict.description: What policy decided. ESCALATED means no automated outcome was reached and a human owns the next step.

rules.description: The individual rules evaluated and their outcomes.

passed.description: True when replaying the same inputs produced the same outcome.

receipt_id.description: Identifier for this receipt. Use it with the ledger and verification endpoints.

admissibility.description: Admissibility status, reported separately from the policy verdict. A decision can be authorized by policy and still not be admissible.

attestations.description: Ed25519 signatures and hash-chain links binding this receipt to its predecessor.
